Hi,

I have just recieved a batch of PFG-01 film (4 * 5 inch) from Integraf. The manufacture date is May 2003 (batch 987). Will they be ok, or should I complain to Integraf?

- I trust they store them in some kind of refrigerator for all this time ???

Many thanks, Rick Anderson.

posts.topic_title: Order from Integraf 18 Months from manuf. date.
posts.author: MichaelH
posts.post_subject: Order from Integraf 18 Months from manuf. date.
posts.content_md:
They're probably ok. I believe they do refrigerate the film while it's waiting to be purchased. I've been using some PFG roll film for almost a year that was manufactured in 2002 and had no problems at all.

If you have any concerns, contact Alex at their support email address and I'm certain he'll be able to explain how they store and use the film themselves.

posts.author: Colin Kaminski
posts.post_subject: Order from Integraf 18 Months from manuf. date.
posts.content_md: My experience with PFG-01 is that the film simply looses sensitivity with time. When I use very old film I have to increase the exposure time. I have some plates that were given to me 3 years ago because they were getting old and the holographer was not going to use them. I just started to use them and I have to double the exposure. I am sure they are at least 5 years old.
